name: GaRAGe
description: A benchmark with grounding annotations intended to evaluate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems' grounding of retrieved visual evidence to generated text.
reputation: A recent, specialized benchmark for retrieval-augmented visual generation with early interest from the multimodal RAG research community but limited broad adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on grounding of retrieved visual evidence; evaluation depends on annotated grounding spans so results can be sensitive to annotation granularity. Newly proposed (2025) dataset with likely limited replication; contamination risk low but depends on whether retrieval corpora overlap with pretraining data.
